an6.61:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
an6.61:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi
an6.61:3.1: katamo nu kho āvuso eko anto katamo dutiyo anto kiṃ majjhe kā sibbanīti.
an6.61:3.2: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca
an6.61:3.3: phasso kho āvuso eko anto phassasamudayo dutiyo anto phassanirodho majjhe taṇhā sibbanī
an6.61:3.4: taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tasseva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā
an6.61:3.5: ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro hotīti.

an6.61:9.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca
an6.61:9.2: byākataṃ kho āvuso amhehi sabbeheva yathāsakaṃ paṭibhāṇaṃ
an6.61:9.3: āyāmāvuso yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamissāma upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocessāma
an6.61:9.4: yathā no bhagavā byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāreyyāmāti.
an6.61:10.1: evamāvusoti kho therā bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paccassosuṃ.
an6.61:10.2: atha kho therā bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu
an6.61:10.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho therā bhikkhū yāvatako ahosi sabbeheva saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesuṃ
an6.61:10.5: sabbesaṃ vo bhikkhave subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena apica yaṃ mayā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ parāyane metteyyapañhe
an6.61:12.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
